scope: Qwen2.5-0.5B-shaped public configuration, 39 input tokens and one generated token; analytic serialized-body lower bounds, not a real-checkpoint MPC run
numeric_scope: The one-use in-process parties match the integer polynomial numerator (256g+g^2)u modulo 2^24 on bounded Q7 inputs; this numerator has scale 65536 and does not match the separately rounded Q7 SiLU-then-multiply composite. The Qwen activation range and its BF16/W8A8 scale transitions have not been admitted.
limits: The two-source bound charges only independent 24-bit masked hidden openings and polynomial coefficients; attention products, softmax, normalization, output shares, transport framing and protected rescaling add cost.
The 24-bit masked-source width is a research assumption, not validated against real Qwen weights or scales.
The dealer and both party objects run in one process for tests; no provider execution, independent operator, full wire, disk or peak memory is measured.
The 6 MB target is a selected tenfold online-body objective, not a proven security lower bound or whole-decoder performance guarantee.
reproduction: uv run --no-sync pytest -q tests/test_shared_gate_reference.py tests/test_shared_gate_projected.py tests/test_shared_gate_polynomial.py tests/test_shared_gate_resources.py
